title: Zwischenbericht Prefer NGS KET Abbreviations
description: Make sure that all KET, NGS, etc. in mit-bestand Zwischenbericht are properly abbreviated via \Abbr{} (so Abkürzungsverzeichnis page hyperlinks populate) and prefer NGS over LUH and KET over UdK whenever the project partner/department is meant. Keep formal cover-page and Mittelverwendung full institution names. Wire \Abbr at occurrences of AP, KI, LLM, HID, REST, NGS, KET, BBSR, and remaining LUH/UdK where those university names must stay.
summary: Wired all Zwischenbericht abbreviations through \Abbr{} so the Abkürzungsverzeichnis collects hyperlinked page references (AP, KI, LLM, HID, REST, NGS, KET, BBSR). Prefer NGS over LUH and KET over UdK in partner/responsibility contexts (operative start, risk table, Erfolgsindikatoren, AP responsibility statements). Removed standalone LUH/UdK AbbreviationDefine entries; NGS/KET definitions still name the parent universities. Left cover and Mittelverwendung full institution names, and bare abbrs in section titles / pre-define front matter. Build verified: 96 pages with page refs and GoTo links for every remaining abbreviation.
